rationale: The workflow already applies the relevant dependency-cache optimization: every job (test, lockfile, rustfmt) initializes Swatinem/rust-cache@v2, and stale in-progress runs are already cancelled via concurrency with cancel-in-progress: true. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern explicitly lists "An equivalent cache already exists" as a contraindication, and its measured evidence is from a Gradle workflow, not this Rust/Cargo workflow. No other workflow-scoped, evidence-supported optimization is safely applicable: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative duration history (risk of false timeouts), P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is meaningless for a single-cell matrix and the ci job requires all results, and the remaining patterns are ci_service/build_configuration scoped or require unverified preconditions. All required checks (test, lockfile, rustfmt) and coverage are preserved, so no change is warranted.
